_comment: SEPARATE from v2, which stays frozen and untouched as the transportability frontier diagnostic. v3 exists to test one narrow question -- after a FIXED Stage 1, is there a small, mechanically motivated Stage 2 that safely resolves part of the middle band -- rather than to widen v2's search. Adding cascade as a fourth family there would have taken the space from 144 combinations to about 570, and the evidence says the problem is not that 144 was too few: v2's nested diagnostic found no feasible policy on 3 of 5 folds' training splits, and the two folds that did select landed at held-out auto-keep precision 0.909 and 0.846 with sharp false-reject 0.067 and 0.097. 313 events cannot stably choose an operating point pressed against 0.95/0.05; quadrupling the search space would find a point that happens to work on the pooled OOF, not one that transports.
_stage1_frozen: Stage 1 is v2's selected agreement rule, carried over verbatim and NOT re-searched: reliability >= 0.70, both branches >= 0.75 to AUTO_KEEP, both <= 0.30 to AUTO_REJECT, disagreement to REVIEW. Only Stage 2's two thresholds vary.

roles._rule_text: Stage 1 fixed; select only Stage 2's two thresholds, maximising FULL-TAXONOMY automatic coverage subject to full-taxonomy auto-keep precision >= 0.95, sharp false-reject <= 0.05, and per-subtype auto-keep caps

selection._scope_comment: FULL taxonomy, not clean binary. v2 was selected on clean-binary precision, which leaves every auto-kept non-clean event out of the denominator: on the development set that reads 0.951 while counting all 64 auto-keeps gives 58/64 = 0.906, and review reads 0.540 against a true 251/412 = 0.609. A cascade optimised on the clean-binary number could reduce review by automatically accepting gradual and ambiguous candidates and never show the cost. The per-subtype caps are DEVELOPMENT constraints only -- the policy never sees a subtype at inference -- and they are zero for offscreen, camera shift, ambiguous and annotation convention because none of those is a boundary decision the system is entitled to make alone.

roles.expected_external_behavior: Buys automatic coverage back from Stage 1's middle band using a score that improves ranking but was never allowed to overrule a confident P1. If it clears the internal gate below it goes to batch4 alongside v2's frontier policy, both frozen, both reported, with no post-hoc choice between them.

_internal_gate_before_batch4._comment: v3 must clear ALL of these on development data before it is allowed anywhere near batch4. Failing them means the evidence supports a useful local representation but not a stable low-review cascade, and the honest response is to leave v3 out of the batch4 run rather than to relax anything here.

families.name: cascade_stage1_frozen
families._grid_comment: NINE candidates, not hundreds. Stage 2 only ever sees what Stage 1 left as insufficient_margin at reliability >= 0.70; low-reliability events and explicit global/local disagreements are deliberately out of its reach, because letting it decide those would make it unconditional fusion again -- and unconditional fusion is the thing that destroyed 8 correct boundaries on the clean-145.
